value.title: ETA drifts by one hour after DST change
value.description:
Depots in Europe/Oslo report ETAs one hour late since the last DST switch.

- [x] Reproduce on staging
- [ ] Add a regression test

Likely related to the server timezone handling.

value.title: Cache warmup blocks startup
value.description: The ETA cache is warmed synchronously before the server listens.

value.title: Customer depot coordinates exposed in debug logs
value.description: Debug logging prints exact depot coordinates for customer sites.

value.title: Discuss switching the geocoding provider
value.description: Collect requirements before we renew the geocoding contract.

value.title: Checkout API returns 500 during peak
value.description: Alert fired from the deployment pipeline: 500 responses on /plan between 17:00 and 17:20 UTC.

value.title: Document the /plan endpoint
value.description: The README lists the endpoint but not its request body.

value.title: Route export to CSV
value.description: Dispatchers want to download planned routes as CSV.

value.title: Nightly deploy job failed
value.description: Deployment to staging failed: registry timeout.

value.title: Support multi-stop optimisation
value.description: Order up to 25 stops to minimise total drive time.

value.title: Show traffic incidents on the route
value.description: Overlay reported incidents on the planned route.

value.title: Retry the geocoder on 429 responses
value.description: Back off and retry when the geocoder rate limits us.

value.title: Timezone setting per depot
value.description: Allow each depot to configure its local timezone for display.

value.title: Improve ETA accuracy for rural routes
value.description: Rural ETAs are consistently 10% optimistic.

value.title: Rotate webhook signing secret
value.description: The payment provider webhook secret is older than 12 months.

value.title: Invoice totals rounding
value.description: Totals drift by one cent on large invoices.

value.title: Fix timezone drift in ETA calculation
value.description:
Pins the server time zone to UTC.

Closes #1 once verified.

value.title: Cap the ETA cache size
value.description:
Evicts the oldest entry once the cache holds 500 routes.

- [x] Unit test
- [ ] Load test on staging

value.title: Add live traffic delay to ETAs
value.description: Adds the traffic provider delay to every estimate.

value.description: Work in progress; stop ordering still undocumented.

value.description: Exploration only; superseded by the REST plan.

value.description: Adds a PDF renderer for invoices.

value.body: I can reproduce this with the Europe/Oslo depot on staging.
The offset is probably computed before the DST switch and cached.
Current provider pricing doubles in January; please add your requirements here.
Can we cap the cache size instead of letting it grow?
Secret rotation window agreed with finance for Friday.
